notes: Play knowledge rewritten as executable actions. Every reference is checked against the generated level data by tools/gen_level_nuance.py.
Bunker 1 is the level where ordering matters most: one objective deliberately raises the alarm, so everything quiet has to be finished first.

nuance.claim: Getting the programmer to the terminal is what raises the alarm, so every quiet objective must be complete before it is attempted.
nuance.because: Objective 3 depends on objective 2 having been done, and the guides agree the terminal use is the alarm trigger.

nuance.claim: The surveillance cameras are cleared first: they are the only objective that punishes being seen, and everything after the programmer is done under alarm anyway.
nuance.because: Objective 0 names four destroy tags and the alarm objective comes later in the dependency chain.

nuance.claim: A camera dies to a single shot on its glass but takes several into the housing, so the shot is aimed at the lens.
The first camera can be destroyed through the window of the starting room's door without opening it, which removes it before it ever sees the player.
Copying the key is not enough; the original has to be dropped afterwards or the objective stays incomplete.
nuance.because: The objective text itself states the original must be left behind.

nuance.claim: The computer room is cleared before the programmer is led there, because a firefight on arrival is fought while babysitting an escort.
The programmer runs for the nearest alarm if the player falls too far behind, so he is followed closely rather than led from ahead.
The computer room keycard is carried by a soldier in the hallways, so a guard must be killed and looted before the escort can even begin.
The bunker fills with reinforcements while the data downloads, so the exit run begins the instant it finishes rather than after a sweep.
After the alarm the level is continuously reinforced, so remaining objectives are done under fire and positions do not stay clear once cleared.
The video screen objective is completed by equipping the watch camera and firing at the screen from the main room; shooting it with a weapon does nothing.
The main exit door is locked and needs a security keycard, so the escape route has a prerequisite that is easy to discover too late.
